name: 75706 · Tyler, TX
findings: ZIP 75706 (Tyler) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75706 (Tyler) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75706 (Tyler) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
